sources.supports: Google says Gemini 3.5 Flash was behind the alias as of its May 19, 2026 release note.

notes: The earlier amounts are official for Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Google identified that model as gemini-flash-latest's target on May 19, 2026. Google later announced 3.6 Flash at a lower price on July 21, but the available first-party evidence does not establish when or whether the alias switched to it; the Internet Archive CDX request returned HTTP 503, so no archival snapshot bracket was obtained.
